svg.title: AIcoach — Upload + analysing (r3-07 Stage Bands)
svg.text: Upload — the filming checklist is drawn onto the swing. The one thing to do is drop the clip.

text.tspan: Send me one swing, filmed down the line.
Here’s where to put the phone.
Face-on clips can’t be analysed. Use a
stand or your bag, not your hand.
· mp4 or mov · max 15 s · one swing

svg.text: Off by default. If on, the swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until you delete it.
Questions open once the result is ready.
Analysing — the swing band fills in with body lines while the steps tick off on paper.
Got it — a clean clip at 120 fps. Watching it now.
Step 3 of 5 · usually under a minute
You can ask about the result when it’s ready.
